prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1159; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across its center and the left tail lamp assembly is broken, with scuffing running along the left quarter panel. The pattern of contact lines up with the low-speed rear impact that was described, and nothing observed suggests older damage on this vehicle. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and tail lamp, refinishing the quarter panel, and a standard alignment check of the rear sensor bracket. The labor hours allotted fit the scope of this work, and the invoices submitted contain no duplicated line items or repeated charges. Parts pricing reflects current OEM listings.
